title: Property picture cards: hard, soft, bendy, stiff, transparent, opaque
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Everyday materials (Moon Zoom! and Rain & Sunrays)
source: Seeded from science/y1 lesson 6 (Property picture cards: hard, soft, bendy, stiff, transparent, opaque (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 6: Hard or soft, bendy or stiff?. To understand that materials have properties we can test by touch and sight

blocks.title: Sort into: Hard / Soft
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Hard, Soft.
blocks.answer: Hard: a stone; a metal spoon; a wooden block. Soft: a sponge; a teddy; a pillow

questions.q: Is a sponge hard or soft?
questions.model: Press it. It squashes. So it is soft.

questions.q: Is a metal spoon bendy or stiff?
Can you see through cling film?
Core: Find four objects at home. Show each one and say 'hard' or 'soft'.
questions.a: For example: book hard, sock soft, cup hard, towel soft
questions.model: Teacher shows it first: this is a towel. I press it. It squashes. It is soft.

questions.q: Extend: Which of your objects is bendy?
questions.a: For example: a sock, a plastic ruler, a rubber band

questions.q: Stretch: Why is a window made of glass and not wood?
questions.a: Glass is transparent, so light comes in and we can see out

questions.q: Big question: which material would you choose for a window, and why?
questions.a: Glass, because it is transparent and hard
